title: SUMX over the items: the measure reference's context transition selects each item in turn

source.quote: The application of a calculation item replaces a measure reference with the expression of the calculation item, still applying an implicit context transition.
source.supports: the measure reference in the row context of an item is evaluated with that item selected

source.quote: There is nothing magical about calculation groups: They are tables, and as such they can be filtered by CALCULATE like any other table.
source.supports: the context transition filters the calculation group table like any other
